items.q: How does the custody calendar work?
items.a: Pick a plan like 7/7 or 10/4, or make your own. Everyone sees whose week it is.
bullets: Swaps are agreed in the app
Appointments with place, tasks and notes

items.q: How do we share photos and videos?
items.a: Post a moment and choose who sees it. Everything is kept in one shared media library.
Necessities for each home, and wishlists the family can pick from. No double gifts.

items.q: Can we add tasks and reminders?
items.a: Yes. Add tasks to appointments and school lessons, with a reminder before they are due.

items.q: Can I see the school day?
items.a: Yes. See when each child starts and ends, and open the full week schedule.

items.q: Where do we keep health info and growth?
items.a: On the child. Medical info like allergies and medicine, and height and weight on WHO growth charts.
Each adult sees only what their role allows. You decide who is invited.

items.q: Can we message each other in KINND?
items.a: Yes. Messages stay inside KINND, next to everything else about your child.

story.lead: Children with two homes have one life. Their photos, plans and small notes should not be split in two.

We believe that privacy matters and take it seriously. You can share your child and media in a private encrypted space outside social media.
